producer_report.summary: The closing commit's Athena-Verifier trailer is now chosen by whether a verifier ran, not by the verdict alone. Root cause: run.rs built `<model> pass|fail` from `final_verdict` whenever a verification existed, so a job rejected by a check looked judged by the verifier. A new pure function `verifier_trailer` in run.rs decides it. If `verifier_invocation` is Some, the value is `<model> pass` or `<model> fail`. Otherwise it is `none (check <first failed check> failed)`, or `none (no verifier ran)` if no check failed. docs/records.md, docs/design/athena-v0.md and CHANGELOG.md describe the new form. The full `cargo test --locked` failed once, on a lifecycle test that hit an "already running in another athena process" error. That test passes when rerun alone. I did not rerun the whole suite afterwards.

checks_run.note: On the full run, 1 test failed: local_edits_block_the_landing_and_go_retries_it, with "job ... is already running in another athena process". Run alone it passes. I did not rerun the whole suite afterwards.
Reruns the one flaky test alone.
Runs the 3 new tests plus the 4 existing pin tests.

criteria_check.criterion: A new unit test in athena-core builds the closing trailers for a verification with verifier_invocation None and a failed check named fmt. It asserts the Athena-Verifier value is exactly `none (check fmt failed)` and does not contain the verifier model name. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
criteria_check.evidence: run::tests::a_job_rejected_by_a_check_says_no_verifier_ran in crates/athena-core/src/run.rs builds a verification with invocation None and a failed `fmt` check. It asserts the value equals `none (check fmt failed)` and does not contain `claude-opus-5-5`. It passes in `cargo test -p athena-core --locked verifier`.

criteria_check.criterion: A test asserts that when verifier_invocation is Some, the trailer is still `<verifier-model> pass` for a pass verdict and `<verifier-model> fail` for a fail verdict. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
criteria_check.evidence: run::tests::a_verifier_that_ran_is_named_with_its_verdict asserts `claude-opus-5-5 pass` and `claude-opus-5-5 fail` with invocation Some(2). It passes in the same run.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` are clean. `cargo test --locked` had one failure on its full run, local_edits_block_the_landing_and_go_retries_it, with an "already running in another athena process" error. It passes when rerun alone, so it looks like a flake from concurrent tests.

criteria_check.criterion: In crates/athena-core/src/run.rs the Athena-Verifier trailer is chosen by whether a verifier invocation exists. The model name appears only when a verifier ran.
criteria_check.evidence: `verifier_trailer` checks `verification.verifier_invocation.is_some()` before using the model name. The closing-commit code calls it.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/records.md documents the `Athena-Verifier: none (check <name> failed)` form beside the `<model> pass` line, so a reader of a rejected job's commit can tell that no verifier judged it.
criteria_check.evidence: docs/records.md has a paragraph right after the trailer block that describes the `none (check <name> failed)` form and the `none (no verifier ran)` fallback.

criteria_check.criterion: The change is focused. No governance files change. CHANGELOG.md gets an entry only if the repo's convention requires one.
criteria_check.evidence: The diff touches only run.rs, docs/records.md, docs/design/athena-v0.md and CHANGELOG.md, all listed deliverables. The changelog entry is under Fixed, as the brief's changelog default asks.

open_issues: The full `cargo test --locked` failed once on a concurrency flake in local_edits_block_the_landing_and_go_retries_it, which passes alone. I did not rerun the whole suite afterwards.
learnings: The lifecycle integration tests can fail with "already running in another athena process" when run concurrently inside the job; they pass alone.
